roads.name: Lakeshore Drive
words: Properly twisty: 22 curves in 3.6 miles, about 6 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From -1 to 15 ft, with 89 ft of up and down along the way.
Built up in places.
Water alongside for stretches.
19 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 91°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 35 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.26 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
